STAGE: design lock for ideation_4 (round three, one mechanism, one frozen run).
GOAL: pick a coupling position that (i) makes the deep partition FINER instead of merging it, (ii) puts the behaviour signal into the TOKENS, (iii) has no objective whose minimum is the origin, (iv) costs <1% of the 0.15 s/epoch Stage-2 budget, (v) is not one of the four already-rejected mechanisms.
READ: round summary in the task (L1/L2/L3 251/1769/2201 -> 0.05439 ; 230/1251/1298 -> 0.05165 ; frozen baseline ~0.0679 ; gate 0.065), the constraint list (a) tree-likeness unavailable, (b) curvature is a gauge and behaviour-contrast predicts recall +0.71 while Gromov-delta and ancestor-depth hurt, (c) origin-min objectives collapse the encoder, (d) behaviour must reach the tokens, and the explicit permission to change level count / codebook size as a Stage-2 architecture hyperparameter.
OBSERVED / REASONING: every negative arm so far was a displacement (move points toward a hub, move codebook centroids, per-level curvature, radial ranking) and each one reduced distinct L3 prefixes. The one consistent correlate of recall in this programme is depth-wise prefix capacity. Therefore the coupling must act on the LABEL PARTITION, not on the coordinates: leave every latent and every learned centroid exactly where Stage 2 put it, and add a deterministic discrete refinement that can only increase the number of distinct deep codes. Chosen: geodesic mitosis of each level-3 cell into two children, with the split direction taken from a behaviour-contrast-weighted tangent scatter at the cell's hyperbolic Frechet mean. Level-3 alphabet 256 -> 512, token count unchanged (3 per item), so Stage 3 sequence length and context are untouched. No loss term is added, so the round-one collapse mode is structurally absent.
OPEN: nothing blocking; the complete proposal is written into the next record. Per the round policy only the both-on arm is trained; behaviour-off (w=1) and geometry-off (Euclidean flat limit) exist as switches but are never run.
EVIDENCE: reasoning only, from the numbers quoted in the task; no file or run was read in this session (no read/shell tool).

STAGE: complete answer, compressed (final record; full text printed in the reply).
IDEA MITOSIS-GEO-BEHL3. Behaviour-contrast geodesic mitosis: split each level-3 RQ-VAE cell into two children along a geodesic through the cell's hyperbolic Frechet mean, oriented by a behaviour-contrast-weighted tangent scatter. Level-3 alphabet 256->512; SID stays 3 tokens; nothing is moved; no loss added.
WHY: both negative rounds lost recall exactly when distinct L3 prefixes fell (2201->0.0544 vs 1298->0.0517), and both did it by displacing coordinates (curved residual chain; concentration-scaled step to successor barycentre). Baseline 0.0679, gate 0.065. So spend new capacity on a split, never on a move. Behaviour contrast is the signal that tracks recall here (+0.71; Gromov-delta -0.12, ancestor-depth -0.075), so it orients the split.
MECHANISM: r_i = z_i-(e1+e2); s = RMS of r over train items; u_i = exp_0(r_i/s) in the unit Poincare ball, c=1 (gauge, declared not tuned), radius <= 1-1e-5. Per cell k: m_k = Karcher mean (5 iters, arithmetic-mean init, monotone-variance fallback). w_i = 1-cos(p_i, sbar_k) from train consecutive-transition successor distributions. L_i = log_{m_k}(u_i); S_k = sum w_i L_i L_i^T / sum w_i; v_k = top eigenvector, sign fixed so sum w_i <L_i,v_k> >= 0. tau_k = 0.5*median d_P(m_k,u_i); a+- = exp_{m_k}(+-tau_k v_k), clamped. score_i = d_P(u_i,a-)-d_P(u_i,a+); theta_k = train median; bit_i = 1[score_i > theta_k]; SID_3 = 2*c3+bit (512). Refresh at epochs 0,250,...,3000 (13x); freeze the epoch-3000 table before Stage 3.
SWITCHES: BEHAVIOUR_OFF w_i=1 (plain curved variance split); GEOMETRY_OFF arithmetic mean, +/-, L2 distance, tau_k = 0.5*median||u_i-m_k||; BOTH_ON as above. Only BOTH_ON is trained: one run, 3000 epochs, four GPUs, batch 4096, frozen Stage 3, no sweep, no seed repeat.
COST: 13 refreshes x ~8e7 flops = 10-15 ms each, ~0.2 s on top of ~450 s Stage 2; 0.07 ms/epoch amortised; ZERO added per-step cost at 24 steps/epoch, 24556 items; +256 level-3 embedding rows (<0.5% params); Stage 3 sequence length unchanged, only vocabulary doubles (<1% per step). Constants: c=1, K=5, 250-epoch period, tau_k and theta_k are measured medians.
LEAKAGE: successor counts, w_i, sbar_k, m_k, v_k, tau_k, theta_k use train-only interactions and the train-only encoder; cold items take their cell's TRAIN median; val/test edges never enter the SID.
OBSERVABLES: distinct L3 prefixes ~double (2201->~4400); 24556/n_SID collisions roughly halve; train-pair bit agreement > 0.5; Stage-3 L3 token accuracy > 1/512; test_recall@10 vs 0.0679, 0.0544, 0.0517.
COUPLING EQ: v_k = argmax sum_i w_beh(i)<log_{m_k}(u_i),v>^2; bit_i = 1[d_P(u_i,exp(-tau_k v_k)) - d_P(u_i,exp(+tau_k v_k)) > median].
SAFEGUARDS: radius clamps around every exp; stable acosh d_P with argument >= 1; non-finite -> bit 0; Karcher variance-monotone fallback; uniform-weight fallback if sum w < 1e-6; deterministic eigen sign and degenerate tie-break; empty-child repair by moving the highest-w item; size-1 cells keep bit 0; no radial term, no origin-attracting loss, so round-one collapse is structurally absent.
RISKS: a balanced but context-unpredictable bit dilutes the 512-way softmax; 1-cos can partly re-encode popularity; isotropic cells degenerate to plain capacity doubling; frozen Stage-3 embeddings were sized for 256 symbols.
EVIDENCE: reasoning from the round numbers in the task; no run or file read in this session.
